# Provenance of the frozen-base stored-default fixtures (review 5691976414)

These artifacts are the production stored-default expressions regenerated by
the pre-PR frozen base source itself, with no hand metadata edits:

- Base commit: f3ca5ef8f781ea0f5d4a2504416bb7dadc153baf (review head
  a53719fe09fa099f965c20d51b31e6fe0c8ec2bf was built on this base).
- Generator: a scratch test harness (zz_frozen_fixture_gen_test.go, not part
  of any upstreamed suite) run in a detached git worktree of that commit via
  the production DDL binding path (BuildPlan with tableDumpBindContext), same
  as the catalog creation path that persisted the originals.
- Raw command: FIXTURE_OUT=<evidence dir> go test -count=1 -run
  'TestGen5691976414FrozenFixtures' ./pkg/sql/plan (native CGO), exit code 0.
- fd.tabledef.pb / jd.tabledef.pb: serialized TableDef of the two review DDLs:
  fd(a varchar(25), b varchar(64) default
  concat(time('12:00:00'), date('2024-01-01'), a));
  jd(a varchar(25), b varchar(64) default
  concat(time('839:00:00'), json_length('null'), a)).
- fd.metadata.txt / jd.metadata.txt: per-node nullability bits of the stored
  default expression as bound by the frozen base. Key published bits:
  fd's folded TIME-derived literal NotNull=true while the DATE-derived
  literal is nullable (the post-8dd/pre-TIME-fix window; neither the current
  binding (both nullable) nor the pre-8dd era (both NOT NULL) reproduces it);
  jd keeps the TIME conversion node with its cast metadata NOT NULL and
  json_length folded under current JSON semantics.

Limitation: these are frozen-base binder reproductions of the historical
catalog shapes, not bytes recovered from a released 4.2.1-hotfix catalog dump;
no real cross-version upgrade or shutdown restore was replayed.
